hamiltonian.normalization: No rescaling of H or time. The Pauli l1 norm is a norm upper bound, not a block-encoding normalization.
hamiltonian.coefficient_semantics: Exact Fraction(str(value)); real ZZ/Z/X family only. Binary64 gates and numerical matrices are separate representations.

source_parameter_rounding.scope: Exact rational bounds on coefficient/angle representation in the ideal gate model, relative to mathematical Suzuki roots; no bound on algorithmic splitting, numerical simulation, synthesis or physical errors. No finite-coefficient order certificate.

logical_ledger.resource_kind: Complete deterministic measured trial before synthesis/fault tolerance; negative substeps retain all gates
logical_ledger.measurement: All n wires inZ; bit0 scores +1/-1
logical_ledger.input_access: Explicit real Pauli coefficients and local gates; no opaque Hamiltonian access or external data-loading oracle
exclusions: Concrete rotation synthesis and its coherent error certificate

planned_sampling_contract.status: Analytic independent-readout proposal; budgeted trials are not executed and algorithm/synthesis/physical allocations are not supplied

validation.qiskit_reference_grouping: Explicit nonempty commuting[A,B] groups; zero blocks omitted as a declared commuting-limit shortcut; source retains its S2 template.
validation.scope: Bounded ideal numerical circuit/product/matrix-exponential comparisons; source parameter enclosures do not certify the large-system splitting error or a physical improvement

measurement_execution.scope: Actual reset/preparation circuit prefix simulated; final expectation calculated from its ideal state. Budgeted repeated trials are not executed.
